34:0.en: 「If you wish, I'll grant you ruin!」

34:82.en: 「This is where myth ends!\nI won't let you interfere!」

34:184.en: 「Never again will you meet\nyour end in peace!」

34:233.en: 「Your memories are unneeded...!\nI want your lives!」

34:384.en: 「The Supreme God's light will\nswallow all of your existence!」

34:435.en: 「I became one with the Supreme God!\nIts power is infinite!」

34:490.en: 「I have surpassed the $$御使い$$s...!\nI am the Supreme God itself!」

34:545.en: 「Right now, an emotion other than\njoy fills my heart!」

34:670.en: 「Moonlight can't dim the Supreme God's light!」

34:713.en: 「Your sun will be painted over by\nthis $$至高神Ｚ$$'s $$黒い太陽#sol$$!」

34:770.en: 「You defy my will, so even\na child won't be forgiven!」

34:821.en: 「None but this $$至高神Ｚ$$ may\nclaim to be Messenger of the Sun!」

34:880.en: 「It is this $$至高神Ｚ$$ that shall\nbe the monument to love!」

34:929.en: 「$$異能生存体$$...!\nI'll send you beyond the causal horizon!」

34:984.en: 「$$ガンダム$$, evolution's guide!\nI'll erase you from the universe!」

34:1049.en: 「$$ガンダム$$!\nVanish from every parallel world!」

34:1104.en: 「Gods and men never understand each other!」

34:1145.en: 「Turning feelings into power...!\nHumanity doesn't need that power!」

34:1200.en: 「A beast less than human\ncan't possibly kill a god!」

34:1251.en: 「$$始原の特異点$$...!\nThere's nothing left you can do!」

34:1312.en: 「That power of life...!\nIt impedes the great collapse!」

34:1365.en: 「Even wings that fly on feelings\ncan't survive the great collapse!」

34:1430.en: 「Demon gods are only monstrous gods!\nThe Supreme God swallows that light!」

34:1495.en: 「Warrior of the $$ゲッター線$$!\nYou should've just fought the void!」

34:1607.en: 「Dominus...!\nFor your sin, I will punish you!」

34:1664.en: 「Don't think you who spurned God's power\ncan face the Supreme God!」

34:1735.en: 「Don't think human feelings\ncan reach a god!」

34:1788.en: 「Not even you can calm\nmy raging soul!」

34:1843.en: 「Mechanical Angel! Vanish into the\n120 million years of darkness!」

34:1906.en: 「No miracle will happen! Because\nI am the one who decides fate!」

34:1973.en: 「I stand where effort and guts\ncan never reach!」

34:2028.en: 「Some things even your $$螺旋力$$\ncan't pierce! That is me!」

34:2083.en: 「Vessel of a god made by human hands!\nVanish here!」

34:2136.en: 「Humanity needs a god!\nI'll teach you that, too!」

34:2236.en: 「Though you were Reactors,\nyou defied me to the very end!」

34:2301.en: 「$$セツコ$$...!\nMourn this world filled with sorrow!」

34:2354.en: 「$$ランド$$...! Let's see how much pain\nyou can endure!」

34:2419.en: 「$$クロウ$$...!\nI'll break your life and your will!」

34:2470.en: 「Your life is mine!\nYes, ever since that time!」

34:2836.en: 「No use fleeing anywhere in the universe!」

34:2873.en: 「Your life is already in the grip\nof the Supreme God and me!」

34:2975.en: 「I give you pain and fear...!\nThat is your punishment!」

34:3024.en: 「I praise the reckless courage that\nfaced the Supreme God past all awe!」

34:3081.en: 「If you'd stayed hidden and quiet,\nyou'd have been spared this...!」

34:3146.en: 「What's given to those who refuse\nsalvation is punishment!」

34:4322.en: 「Why won't you give up!?\nDo you lack the brains to think!?」

34:4375.en: 「You should be at your limit,\nyou must realize it...!」

34:4426.en: 「This is...!\n$$アサキム$$'s will in the Supreme God!?」

34:4514.en: 「This is...! Something we forgot\n120 million years ago...!?」

34:4624.en: 「Impossible! I am the Supreme God,\nbeyond the $$御使い$$s!」

34:4685.en: 「I am eternal! Even if the universe\nperishes, I should survive!」

34:4754.en: 「Does mere moonlight outshine\nthe Supreme God's light...!?」

34:4807.en: 「That man...!\nHe's truly with the sun's radiance!」

34:4858.en: 「A child fretting over a company safe...!」

34:4901.en: 「The name Messenger of the Sun\nis no mere show...!」

34:4954.en: 「Love's power, light and dark fused...!\nIs that his strength!?」

34:5044.en: 「$$始原の特異点$$! Gathering people's will!」

34:5087.en: 「$$ガンダム$$ and its pilot challenge me!」

34:5130.en: 「$$シンカ$$ beyond evolution...!\n$$ガンダム$$, the one that leads to it!」

34:5189.en: 「This heat...! Fight of the beast-blood heir!」

34:5232.en: 「Limitless power of life!\nThis one's existence is a universe!?」

34:5281.en: 「I saw a golden triangle in those wings...!」

34:5320.en: 「Demon God of Light...!\nPower fit to face the Supreme God!?」

34:5377.en: 「Warrior of the $$ゲッター線$$!\nYou can beat the void, not surpass me!」

g034.basis: Calls himself one with the Supreme God Z (至高神Ｚ), above the Angels (御使い), 120 million years ago, punishes Setsuko/Rand/Crowe, names Asakim; this is Holy Advent in the Supreme God Z finale, matching g032/g033 (Jigoku had no identification)

uncertain: Speaker: Holy Advent (Supreme God Z) inferred from lines; token could also be Advent#pilot
34:1607 Dominus (ドミュナス) = Big O's Dominus Roger Smith, from Jigoku g300 'No Dominus needed'
34:4858/4807/4901/821/880 target identities (child with company safe, Messenger of the Sun, monument of love) not verified; 'child' and 'those wings' kept gender/identity neutral
34:5130 真化 rendered with token $$シンカ$$ as noun
34:713 黒い太陽 used #sol variant for Z's Black Sun
